meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw agent 装上 Vercel CLI,并配置 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭据,之后 agent 就能把 web 应用部署到 Vercel。过程中会检查前置条件、把技能同步到已有 agent 组并重启运行中的容器。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把 web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发,通常是运行 /add-vercel。若检测到 OneCLI 未就绪,会先让你运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 给我的 agent 加上 Vercel 部署能力
say.note: 安装 Vercel CLI 并配置凭据注入

say.text: 这是我的 Vercel token,帮我配好
say.note: 创建绑定 api.vercel.com 的凭据

say.text: 用 vercel deploy 把这个应用发到线上
say.note: 在容器内执行部署命令

howto.what_en: Installs the Vercel CLI into your NanoClaw agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials automatically, so agents can deploy web apps to Vercel. It also syncs skills to existing groups and restarts containers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want agents to deploy web applications to Vercel, usually by running /add-vercel. If OneCLI is missing, it asks you to run /init-onecli first.

say_en.text: Add Vercel deployment to my agents
say_en.note: Installs the Vercel CLI and sets up credential injection

say_en.text: Here's my Vercel token, configure it for me
say_en.note: Creates a Vercel API Token secret for api.vercel.com

say_en.text: Deploy this app to production with vercel deploy
say_en.note: Runs the deploy command inside the container
